findings.issue: A stale all-stage receipt does not establish that no newer worker is running; inventories and summaries are read without all case locks.
findings.required_change: Hold all12 shared RunLocks while checking every start/result pair, terminal summaries and inventory and while writing closure. Runner must check closure before every new dispatch. Reject active/unpaired invocations and unknown/nonterminal statuses.
findings.reproduction_shape: Completed prior all invocation plus newer all invocation with start/no result and an unchanged prior summary currently passes the receipt check.

findings.issue: Inventory excludes summaries/worker receipts; current analyzer does not compare recorded closure summary hashes or enforce provenance freeze/source/ledger bindings.
findings.required_change: Validate closure summary digests and freeze/protocol/source/config/ledger before deriving prospective status; bind lifecycle evidence or retain explicit independently verified records.
